location.name: Location
location.heading: Where is your home?
location.intro: Where the house stands decides how much sun your roof gets across the year.

roof.name: Roof
roof.heading: What does your roof look like?
roof.intro: Pick the roof face that is largest and least shaded. A rough figure is fine.

electricity.name: Electricity
electricity.heading: How much power do you use?
electricity.intro: What you spend on electricity tells us how many rupiah solar can save.

lifestyle.name: Habits
lifestyle.heading: When does your home use power?
lifestyle.intro: Panels only save the power you use while the sun is up. These four questions help us guess when your home uses it.

nav.incomplete: Answer every question above to continue.

billing.legend: How do you pay for electricity?
billing.help: This changes how we ask about your spending.

power.label: Connected power
power.help: Printed on your meter or your bill.

prepaid.legend: How much do you top up in a month?
prepaid.help: Add up every token you buy in one month.

postpaid.legend: How big is your monthly electricity bill?
postpaid.help: Check the PLN Mobile app or a payment receipt.

spend.moreMonthsNote: One month is enough. Each extra month sharpens the estimate. We use the average, so the order of the months does not matter.
spend.fullYearNote: With all twelve months the order matters: we read them from January to December so the seasons count.

homeOnWeekdays.help: A parent at home, a retiree, a child studying from home.

daytimeAc.legend: Is the air conditioning on in the daytime?
daytimeAc.help: Any air conditioning that runs while the sun is up.

workFromHome.help: Computers and lights left on all day add to daytime use.

electricVehicle.legend: Is an electric vehicle charged at home?
electricVehicle.help: An electric car or motorbike plugged in at your house.

privacy: Your result is saved under a random code nobody can guess: the pin location, roof, electricity and habits you entered. No name, email or account.

submitFailed.title: Your result was not saved
submitFailed.body: Your answers are still safe on this device. Check your connection, then press Try again.

errors.billRequired: The amount is missing. Type it in rupiah, for example 650,000.
errors.billingRequired: Choose how you pay: tokens or a monthly bill.
errors.powerRequired: Connected power is not chosen. Pick one from the list; it is printed on your meter or bill.
errors.tooManyMonths: Twelve months at most. Remove the extra months.
errors.answerRequired: This question is not answered. Choose Yes or No.
errors.latitudeInvalid: Latitude must be a number between -90 and 90, for example -7.78.
errors.longitudeInvalid: Longitude must be a number between -180 and 180, for example 110.37.
errors.areaInvalid: The roof area is missing. Type the number in square metres, for example 48.
errors.areaTooLarge: A roof this large is not a house roof, so it cannot be calculated. The limit is 2,000 m²; enter one roof face only.
errors.usableInvalid: The usable share of the roof must be above 0 and at most 100%.
errors.facingRequired: Choose which way the roof faces.
errors.shadeRequired: Choose how much shade the roof gets.
errors.billNotWhole: Type whole rupiah, with no decimals: digits only (650000) or grouped in threes (650,000).
errors.billZero: The amount cannot be zero. Type what you spend on electricity in a month, for example 650,000.
errors.billTooHigh: That is too much for your connection. Check the number of zeros.

submitInvalid.title: Some answers are incomplete
submitInvalid.body: We took you to the step that needs finishing. Fill in what is missing, then continue.
